run_ProcessProjectAria: run the CLI tool to extract Project Aria VRS data into NeRFstudio transforms.json format
run_interpolate_aria_pose: run the interpolation function to compute a pose at a given nanosecond timestamp from a closed-loop trajectory
run_bisection_timestamp_search: run a binary search to find the closest trajectory pose index for a given nanosecond timestamp
run_to_aria_image_frame: run the extraction function to convert VRS sensor data into NeRFstudio-compatible image frames with poses
run_visualize_frames: run the Rerun visualization tool to display extracted frames and 3D point clouds from a transforms.json folder
